        "the fixed criteria. Do not accept self-reported model confidence.",
        "Gripper includes both fingers, dark finger pads and fingertips, not merely the white wrist housing or forearm. Localize the complete hand including its lowest protruding tips. Wrist-view fingers may be visible only partly at image edges; dark pads must not be mistaken for the table or background.",
        "Before released/clear_of_target=true, inspect fingertip-to-target AND fingertip-to-support gaps in each useful view. Visible touch or wrap around a bottle neck/rim means false; if the fingertip gap is occluded or tips cannot be identified and no other view resolves it, use null, not an assertion that fingers are retracted. Do not infer lack of contact solely from the main object's body being clear.","}]}
